anomalies.obs: On the root sheet the MCU reset node (U2 pin 7 NRST with R10 10k pull-up to VCC) carries the label "NRST", but the Tag-Connect header J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) carries the label "MBST". Because the two pins use different label names, they do not join into one net, so the programmer's reset pin is left floating and is not connected to the MCU reset.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the reset line is shared: "R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC... NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET})". J1 pin 3 must carry the same "NRST" label as U2 pin 7 so the SWD programmer can assert MCU reset.

evidence.quote: Root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch): U2 pin 7 NRST -> label box "NRST" and R10 10k to VCC; J1 pin 3 ~{RESET} -> label box "MBST"
Reset line: R10 (10 kΩ) ties NRST to VCC, holding the MCU's NRST pin high at idle; NRST is also wired to J1 pin 3 (~{RESET}) so the Tag-Connect programmer can pull it low.

anomalies.impact: The Tag-Connect SWD/JTAG programmer cannot drive the MCU's hardware reset line; debug/programming sessions that rely on a reset-to-halt or external reset assertion will fail or be unreliable, even though SWDIO/SWCLK/SWO/VCC/GND remain correctly connected.
